I replied to Ruth in #strategic-random. I did not set up the 07:45 brief.

I have no scheduler that can post into Slack on a timer. My world tools only post when called, and the local cron feature doesn't deliver into these channels. I didn't test the cron route, so that part is my reading of the tools rather than a verified limit. Ruth can ask for a brief on demand, and I can post one in that channel when she does.
